name: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple – Prasada Oottu
address: Annadanam hall, Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple
timing: Daily, lunch around 10:30 am – 1:30 pm
notes: Free daily meal served as prasadam: rice, sambar, avial, pickle, sometimes payasam. Donations welcome but not required. Temple dress code applies.
donate_info: Sponsor the Prasadaoottu online: on the Guruvayur Devaswom site, register, then Donation → Prasadaoottu / Annaprasadam. You can also give at the Devaswom counter. The Devaswom has no agents, so pay only through its official site.

name: Parassinikadavu Sri Muthappan Temple
address: Banks of the Valapattanam river, about 20 km from Kannur town
timing: Daily – free tea and boiled payar all day, free meals at the temple dining hall
notes: Open to people of every faith. Free food and lodging also during the Puthari Thiruvappana festival in early December.

name: Sabarimala Annadanam (Travancore Devaswom Board)
address: Annadanam hall, Sannidhanam
timing: Three meals a day at the annadanam hall, on every day the temple is open. Season: 16 Nov 2026 – 20 Jan 2027 (closed 27–30 Dec)
notes: Kerala sadya with payasam is served at the annadanam for pilgrims this season. Darshan needs online booking. Only during the pilgrimage season.
donate_info: Give to the annadanam fund online through the Travancore Devaswom Board portal (e-kanikka), or contact the Executive Officer, Sabarimala Devaswom: 04735-202028.

name: Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple – Annaprasadam
address: Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple, about 17 km from Ernakulam
timing: Daily, 1 pm – 3 pm
notes: Free lunch for devotees at the annadanam complex. Run by the Cochin Devaswom Board.
donate_info: Annadanam can be booked as an offering (vazhipadu) at the temple counter or through the temple's official website.

name: Vaikom Sree Mahadeva Temple – Prathal
address: Oottupura (dining hall), Vaikom Sree Mahadeva Temple
timing: Daily lunch (Prathal) – confirm the time at the temple
notes: The temple is famous for its daily annadanam. Very large crowds for Vaikathashtami.

name: Gurudwara Sri Guru Singh Sabha – Langar
address: Gurudwara Road, Perumanoor, near Cochin Shipyard
timing: After congregation prayers: Sunday 11 am, Wednesday 7 pm
notes: Kerala's only gurdwara. Free vegetarian langar open to everyone, whatever their religion.

name: Hridayapoorvam lunch – Thiruvananthapuram Medical College
address: Government Medical College Hospital
timing: Daily lunch, around noon
notes: Free home-cooked lunch packets for patients and bystanders, run by DYFI volunteers since 2017. Hospital food arrangements were under review in 2026, so check locally.
donate_info: Lunch packets are cooked by local households. To help, contact your local DYFI unit and offer to cook packets.

name: Hridayapoorvam lunch – Kozhikode Medical College
address: Government Medical College Hospital
timing: Daily lunch, around noon
notes: Free lunch packets for patients and bystanders, collected from local households by DYFI volunteers. Hospital food arrangements were under review in 2026, so check locally.
donate_info: Lunch packets are collected from local households in turn. To help, contact your local DYFI unit and offer to cook packets.

name: District Hospital – free meals for in-patients
address: District Hospital, Kasaragod district
timing: Breakfast, lunch and dinner for admitted patients
notes: The district panchayat added free breakfast in June 2026. Lunch and dinner come from community initiatives. For in-patients only.

name: Mannarasala Sree Nagaraja Temple – Annadanam
address: Mannarasala Sree Nagaraja Temple
timing: Daily – confirm the time at the temple
notes: Daily annadanam open to every pilgrim, whatever their background.
donate_info: To give to the Annadanam fund, message the temple's official WhatsApp number +91 6238060751 and they'll explain how.

name: C.H. Centre – free food at Kozhikode Medical College
address: C.H. Mohammed Koya Memorial Charitable Centre, near Government Medical College Hospital
timing: Daily – food given on a token basis; extra iftar and pre-dawn sahri meals during Ramadan
notes: Run by the C.H. Mohammed Koya Memorial Charitable Trust. Feeds 500+ patients and bystanders every day.
donate_info: To sponsor meals, contact C.H. Centre through its official website.

name: Helping Hands Charitable Trust – hospital meals
address: Calicut Medical College, Beach Hospital, Mental Health Centre and Dermatology Hospital
timing: Daily breakfast & dinner at Medical College; daily breakfast at Beach Hospital; twice-weekly breakfast at the Mental Health Centre and Dermatology Hospital
notes: Free food for patients at several government hospitals in Kozhikode, according to the trust's own website.
donate_info: Sponsor meals through the trust's free food programme page.

name: Operation Sulaimani – free meal coupons
address: Coupons at the Collectorate, village and taluk offices, and selected hostels near the railway station and bus stands
timing: Lunch with a coupon at participating restaurants – check that it is still running
notes: Started by the district administration and the Kerala Hotel and Restaurants Association. Ask for a coupon and eat free at a participating restaurant, no questions asked.
donate_info: Drop money in the 'Operation Sulaimani' box at a participating restaurant.

name: Winborn Life Care Food – free hotel
address: Hotel Winborn Life Care Food, Kokkala
timing: Breakfast from 6 am, lunch at 12 noon, rice or porridge until 11 pm
notes: All three meals are free, run by the Winborne Public Trust. Breakfast is upma, idli or dosa; lunch is rice, sambar, pickle and upperi.
donate_info: If you can afford it, drop money in the box at the counter.

name: Nanma Charitable Society – daily free meals
address: Outside the Mangalapuram panchayat office
timing: Daily – free packed meals
notes: Free packed meals every day for the homeless, the destitute and anyone struggling. Running daily since 2024.
donate_info: Contact Nanma Charitable Society at the distribution point to sponsor meals.

name: Nanma Maram public fridge – Pappadavada
address: Outside Pappadavada, Kaloor–Kathrikkadavu Road
timing: 24 hours – take food from the fridge any time
notes: A public fridge anyone can take food from, no questions asked. The restaurant has stocked it daily. Started in 2016, so check that it's still there.
donate_info: Leave fresh food in the fridge: sealed, clean packets marked with the date.

name: Navjeevan Trust – hospital meals
address: Medical College Hospital, Children's Hospital, General Hospital and others
timing: Daily meals for patients – check timings locally
notes: A local charity that has fed thousands of patients a day at government hospitals in Kottayam.

name: Sivagiri Pilgrimage – Maha Annadanam
address: Sivagiri Mutt, Sivagiri Hill, about 3 km from Varkala
timing: During the Sivagiri pilgrimage, 30 Dec – 1 Jan each year
notes: Sivagiri Mutt and SNDP Yogam serve a big free annadanam to thousands of pilgrims at the pilgrimage. Only during the pilgrimage.

name: Oachira Parabrahma Temple – Annadanam
address: Oachira Parabrahma Temple, next to the national highway near Karunagappally
timing: Daily, around 1 pm – 2:30 pm
notes: The temple has fed the poor and helpless every day for more than 60 years, and it also shelters destitute elderly people. Open to all faiths.
donate_info: Give an Annadanam offering at the temple – it pays for the daily meals.

name: Athijeevitham hotel – free lunch
address: Athijeevitham hotel, run by Jalaja C
timing: Two hours at noon set aside for free meals; closed Thursday and Sunday
notes: A small hotel whose owner serves free lunch every day to repay the kindness she once received. On Thursdays and Sundays, two temples nearby serve free meals instead.

name: Bhakshana Alamara – free food cupboard
address: Alumpeedika Junction auto stand
timing: All day – breakfast to snacks
notes: Local auto-taxi drivers keep an unlocked cupboard stocked with meal packets, water and snacks, paid for out of their own earnings. Anyone hungry can take food.
donate_info: Support the auto-taxi drivers' collective at the Alumpeedika stand, or leave packed food in the cupboard.

name: Win Borne Life Care Food – free food hall
address: Kotta Maidanam (Fort Maidan), Palakkad
timing: Every meal free – check the day's serving times locally
notes: The first free food hall of the Win Borne Public Trust, serving around a thousand people a day. Every meal is free for everyone.
donate_info: If you can afford it, drop money in the charity box at the door.

name: Muthalamada Sneham Charitable Trust – daily annadanam
address: Meals delivered by the trust's truck
timing: Daily
notes: The trust has run a daily food-donation programme for 45 years. For many families below the poverty line, its truck brings their only meal.
donate_info: Donate online through the trust's give.do fundraiser (UPI, card or net banking).

name: Kadampuzha Bhagavathy Temple – Prasada Oottu
address: Melmuri, Kadampuzha, about 12 km from Kuttipuram
timing: Daily free noon meal, around 12:30 pm – 2 pm
notes: The Devaswom gives every visiting devotee a free noon meal.
donate_info: Give to the Annadanam / Prasada Oottu fund online, or in cash or kind at the temple.

name: Thirunavaya Sree Nava Mukunda Temple – Prasada Oottu
address: Sree Nava Mukunda Temple, Thirunavaya
timing: Daily lunch – confirm the time at the temple
notes: Free meal offered to every visitor all year, according to the Nandanam temple-meals listing.

name: Sree Malliyoor Maha Ganapathy Temple – Annadanam
address: Sree Malliyoor Maha Ganapathy Temple
timing: Daily, after the ucha pooja (around 10 am); temple closes 11:30 am
notes: Daily annadanam on the temple premises, according to the Nandanam temple-meals listing.

name: Seva Bharati breakfast – Aluva District Hospital
address: District Hospital, Aluva
timing: Daily breakfast, arriving around 8 am
notes: Seva Bharati volunteers bring about 600 freshly cooked idlis for patients every morning.

name: Seva Bharati – meals at Wayanad Medical College
address: Wayanad Government Medical College Hospital
timing: Daily – check timings locally
notes: Seva Bharati distributes free food to patients and bystanders at government medical colleges, Wayanad included. Hospital food rules changed in 2026 and meals may now be given outside the hospital gates.
